<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>关于你</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><text y='.9em' font-size='90'>🎁</text></svg>">
<style>
:root{}
@media (max-width: 560px){}
/* 发布到公网后，托管平台会在页面尾部注入一个「Created by MiniMax Agent」的浮动角标。
   这封信是给人看的私人物品，不要那个角标 —— 压掉它。
   （平台那段注入的 <style> 在文档更靠后的位置，所以这里必须用 !important 才压得住。） */
#minimax-floating-ball{display:none !important}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#05030a}
body{font-family:'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
canvas#sky{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;display:block}
.scene{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity 1.35s cubic-bezier(.45,.05,.35,1)}
.scene.active{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}

/* 密码 */
#scene-pass{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 45%,transparent 45%,rgba(2,2,6,.4))}
.pw-stage{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:40px;padding:0 5vw}
.pw-title{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(19px,4.6vw,34px);letter-spacing:.22em;color:#fce8f0;white-space:nowrap;opacity:0;filter:blur(6px);animation:titleTextIn 1.4s 1.6s both;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,190,220,.55)}
@keyframes titleTextIn{from{opacity:0;filter:blur(6px);transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;filter:blur(0);transform:translateY(0)}}
.pw-line{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:nowrap}
.pw-label{font-size:clamp(16px,4.2vw,30px);color:#f2dfe9;white-space:nowrap;opacity:0;animation:fadeUpSoft 1.2s 2.8s both}
.pw-line>.pw-label:first-child{margin-right:clamp(10px,1.8vw,20px)}
.pw-line>.pw-label:last-child{margin-left:clamp(14px,2.4vw,26px)}
@keyframes fadeUpSoft{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.pw-boxes{display:flex;gap:clamp(7px,1.4vw,11px)}
.pw-box{width:clamp(44px,11vw,64px);height:clamp(50px,12.5vw,72px);border:1.5px solid rgba(255,205,232,.32);border-radius:11px;background:rgba(20,15,28,.46);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fce8f0;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(24px,6vw,36px);text-transform:uppercase;opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px);transition:.55s}
.pw-box.activated{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.pw-box.filled{background:rgba(30,22,40,.58);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,180,220,.42);text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,205,232,.7)}
.pw-box.wrong{border-color:rgba(255,130,150,.72);background:rgba(40,14,22,.55);color:#ffafc3}
.pw-stage.shake{animation:shake .55s}
@keyframes shake{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}18%{transform:translateX(-9px)}40%{transform:translateX(9px)}62%{transform:translateX(-6px)}82%{transform:translateX(6px)}}
.pw-stage.ok .pw-box{border-color:rgba(255,205,232,.7);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,190,230,.6);animation:boxPop .55s}
@keyframes boxPop{0%{transform:scale(1)}42%{transform:scale(1.14)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
.pw-hint{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:12vh;transform:translateX(-50%);color:rgba(205,195,220,.55);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:3px;opacity:0;animation:fadeUpSoft 1.2s 3.2s both}
#pwInput{position:fixed;left:50%;top:50%;width:1px;height:1px;opacity:.01;border:0;background:transparent;color:transparent;z-index:5}

/* 信纸 */
.letter-stage{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:4vh 0}
.scroll-wrap{position:relative;width:min(560px,78vw);height:min(74vh,680px);opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px) scale(.98);transition:1.4s}
.scene.active .scroll-wrap{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}
.roller{position:absolute;left:-22px;right:-22px;height:46px;z-index:5;filter:drop-shadow(0 16px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.62))}
.roller-top{top:-23px}.roller-bottom{bottom:-23px}
.roller-body{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:23px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#7c6238,#a88a5a 6%,#cdbb99 14%,#e0d0b0 22%,#efe3c9 30%,#fdf8ec 42%,#f2e8d2 54%,#e0d0b0 64%,#c8b48a 74%,#a08a5e 84%,#7c6238 92%,#4a3520);box-shadow:inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255,250,220,.7),inset 0 -3px 8px rgba(35,18,6,.78)}
.roller-cap{position:absolute;top:50%;width:40px;height:40px;margin-top:-20px;border-radius:50%;z-index:6;background:radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%,#b98a52,#8a5f30 20%,#5a3a18 50%,#36200a 78%,#1e1004);box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.72),inset -3px -4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.55),inset 3px 3px 8px rgba(255,220,180,.5)}
.roller-cap-l{left:-20px}.roller-cap-r{right:-20px}
.roll-bundle{position:absolute;left:-12px;right:-12px;top:50%;height:0;transform:translateY(-50%);border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fbf1d6,#f4e5be 16%,#ead6a6 36%,#dcc08b 56%,#c8a874 76%,#a88850 92%,#7e6238);z-index:1}
.paper-viewport{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:100%;overflow:hidden;z-index:2;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.72),inset 0 0 80px rgba(120,90,50,.14)}
.paper-surface{position:relative;width:100%;min-height:100%;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fefaf0,#fdf7e8 26%,#faf1d8 52%,#f6e9c8 74%,#f1dfb8);transform-origin:top left}
.paper-content{position:relative;padding:6vh 8vw 8vh;color:#4b3a26;font-family:'STKaiti','KaiTi',serif;font-size:clamp(17px,2.3vw,21px);line-height:2.28}
.paper-orn{text-align:center;color:#d4b688;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:8px;margin-bottom:4vh}
.letter-title{font-size:clamp(21px,2.9vw,27px);color:#5a4632;margin-bottom:4vh;font-weight:400}
.letter-greet{font-size:clamp(19px,2.6vw,24px);color:#7a5a35;margin-bottom:5vh}
.letter-p{text-indent:2em;margin-bottom:2.2vh}
.letter-p-gap{margin-top:4vh}
.letter-sign{text-align:right;margin-top:6vh;font-size:clamp(24px,3.2vw,32px);letter-spacing:4px;color:#5a4632}
@keyframes letterFadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.scene.active .paper-content>*{animation:letterFadeUp 1s both}
.scene.active .paper-content>:nth-child(1){animation-delay:1.35s}
.scene.active .paper-content>:nth-child(2){animation-delay:1.5s}
.scene.active .paper-content>:nth-child(3){animation-delay:1.68s}
.scene.active .paper-content>:nth-child(4){animation-delay:1.86s}
.scene.active .paper-content>:nth-child(5){animation-delay:2.02s}
.scene.active .paper-content>:nth-child(6){animation-delay:2.18s}
.scene.active .paper-content>:nth-child(7){animation-delay:2.34s}
.scene.active .paper-content>:nth-child(8){animation-delay:2.56s}
.scene.active .paper-content>:nth-child(9){animation-delay:2.8s}
.scene.active .paper-content>:nth-child(10){animation-delay:2.95s}
.roll-btn{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:2vh;padding:10px 30px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(255,205,235,.28);background:rgba(30,20,35,.5);color:#fce8f0;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:3px;cursor:pointer;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(14px);transition:.9s;z-index:20}
.roll-btn.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}

/* 卷轴 */
.scroll-wrap2{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer}
.scroll-svg{height:min(56vh,410px);width:calc(min(56vh,410px)*200/430);filter:drop-shadow(0 20px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.6));animation:sway 4.2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes sway{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-8deg)}50%{transform:rotate(-3.5deg) translateY(-12px)}}
.scroll-tip{margin-top:46px;color:rgba(255,220,170,.9);font-size:16px;letter-spacing:5px;animation:pulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:.55}50%{opacity:1}}

/* 火柴蛋糕 */
#scene-match{background:transparent;touch-action:none}
.matchbox{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:min(280px,68vw);aspect-ratio:260/320;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:11;pointer-events:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 30px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.75));transition:opacity .9s}
.matchbox.gone{opacity:0}
.strike-strip{position:absolute;left:78.5%;width:7.7%;top:10%;height:80%}
.strike-hint{position:absolute;left:50%;top:20%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:14;color:#ffe9c4;font-size:clamp(13px,3.4vw,16px);letter-spacing:3px;white-space:nowrap;padding:9px 18px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(20,18,30,.72);border:1px solid rgba(255,215,140,.35);opacity:0;transition:.8s;pointer-events:none}
.strike-hint.show{opacity:1}
#match{position:absolute;left:50%;top:60%;width:10px;height:150px;margin:-75px 0 0 -5px;z-index:12;will-change:transform}
.match-stick{position:absolute;left:0;top:34px;width:10px;height:116px;border-radius:5px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#a5713c,#e2bd84 45%,#7c5427);box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.match-head{position:absolute;left:-6px;top:14px;width:22px;height:32px;border-radius:48% 48% 46% 46%/58% 58% 42% 42%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 28%,#ff8d6e,#d04a3a 38%,#7e1f18);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.match-flame{position:absolute;left:-15px;top:-32px;width:30px;height:48px;transform-origin:50% 100%;transform:scale(0);transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,1.7,.4,1)}
.match-flame .core{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50% 50% 50% 50%/62% 62% 38% 38%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 76%,#fffafc,#ffe2f0 24%,#ffb8d8 46%,#ff8fc0 62%,rgba(255,130,180,0) 82%);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(255,200,225,.95)) drop-shadow(0 0 34px rgba(255,150,200,.62));animation:flameFlick .17s infinite alternate}
.match-flame.lit{transform:scale(1)}
@keyframes flameFlick{0%{transform:translateX(-1px) scaleY(1)}33%{transform:translateX(1px) scaleY(1.06)}66%{transform:translateX(0) scaleY(.96)}100%{transform:translateX(-1px) scaleY(1.04)}}
#lightPool{position:absolute;left:50%;top:55%;width:110vmin;height:110vmin;border-radius:50%;z-index:11;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,230,242,.35),rgba(255,160,210,.1) 42%,transparent 88%);filter:blur(14px);mix-blend-mode:screen;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.5);transition:.5s}
#cake{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:4%;width:min(400px,92vw);height:540px;z-index:10;opacity:0;--sc:1;transform-origin:50% 100%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(50px) scale(var(--sc));transition:opacity 1.6s,transform 1.6s;pointer-events:none}
#cake.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0) scale(var(--sc))}
@media (max-height:820px){#cake{--sc:.9}}
@media (max-height:700px){#cake{--sc:.78}}
#cake::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-16px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%,rgba(0,0,0,.9),transparent 76%);filter:blur(9px);z-index:-1}
.cake-stand{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:0;transform:translateX(-50%);width:378px;height:56px}
.stand-disc{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 26%,rgba(255,255,255,.9) 0%,transparent 62%),linear-gradient(180deg,#fbfbfd,#e2e2ec 42%,#b6b6c4 78%,#888 96%);box-shadow:0 24px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.72),inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255,255,255,.95)}
.stand-slate{position:absolute;bottom:14px;left:2%;right:2%;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2a2a36,#161620 46%,#09090f 88%,#030306);box-shadow:inset 0 -8px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.85),0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.cyl{position:absolute;inset:0}
.cyl-cap{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;border-radius:50%;z-index:2}
.cyl-body{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;z-index:1;overflow:hidden}
.cyl-texture{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;mix-blend-mode:overlay}
.layer-bottom{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:40px;transform:translateX(-50%);width:300px;height:150px}
.layer-bottom .cyl-cap{height:28px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 45%,#4a4a60,#303040 22%,#1c1c2a 48%,#0e0e16 74%,#05050a 94%,#020204)}
.layer-bottom .cyl-body{top:14px;bottom:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#020204,#05050a 5%,#0d0d15 12%,#1a1a26 22%,#28283a 32%,#333348 42%,#38384e 48%,#38384e 52%,#333348 58%,#28283a 68%,#1a1a26 78%,#0d0d15 88%,#05050a 95%,#020204);box-shadow:inset 0 -30px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.78),0 20px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.75)}
.layer-bottom .cyl-texture{opacity:.7;background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(74deg,rgba(255,255,255,.045) 0 1.5px,transparent 1.5px 5.5px),repeating-linear-gradient(-22deg,rgba(0,0,0,.2) 0 1px,transparent 1px 7px)}
.layer-top{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:176px;transform:translateX(-50%);width:220px;height:130px}
.layer-top .cyl-cap{height:24px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 34%,rgba(255,255,255,.95),#fdf6e6 22%,#f0e4d0 42%,#ddceb6 68%,#c2b096 88%,#a8947a);box-shadow:inset 0 3px 6px rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.layer-top .cyl-body{top:12px;bottom:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#b4a690,#cec0aa 6%,#e2d4be 14%,#f2e6d0 24%,#fbf0da 34%,#fff9e8 44%,#fffcf0 50%,#fdf6e2 56%,#f0e4ce 66%,#e0d2b8 76%,#c8b8a0 86%,#b0a088 94%,#98866e);box-shadow:inset 0 -22px 30px rgba(150,130,110,.4),0 22px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.layer-top .cyl-texture{opacity:.55;mix-blend-mode:soft-light;background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(93deg,rgba(255,255,255,.9) 0 1px,rgba(180,168,150,.24) 1px 3px,rgba(255,255,255,.65) 3px 5px)}
.ring-pearls{position:absolute;left:-2%;right:-2%;height:16px;z-index:5;pointer-events:none;background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 4.8px 4.4px,#ffffff 0 1.8px,rgba(255,246,228,.95) 1.8px 2.8px,rgba(190,168,148,.5) 2.8px 3.8px,rgba(120,95,75,.3) 3.8px 4.6px,transparent 4.6px),radial-gradient(circle at 7.6px 10.4px,rgba(60,40,28,.5) 0 1.6px,transparent 2.4px);background-size:15px 16px;background-repeat:repeat-x;background-position:center 0,center 4px;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.55));-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0%,#000 10%,#000 90%,transparent 100%);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0%,#000 10%,#000 90%,transparent 100%)}
.ring-bottom{bottom:-8px}
.ring-top{bottom:-8px;background-size:13px 16px}
.medallion{position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);aspect-ratio:100/124;z-index:6;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.6))}
.medallion-lg{top:36px;width:76px}
.medallion-sm{top:26px;width:60px}
.bow{position:absolute;width:92px;height:150px;bottom:-96px;z-index:7;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.55));pointer-events:none}
.bow-l{left:-12%}
.bow-r{right:-12%;transform:scaleX(-1)}
.candelabra{--u:calc(min(230px,60vw,26vh)/220);position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:290px;transform:translateX(-50%);width:calc(220*var(--u));height:calc(180*var(--u));z-index:8}
.candelabra svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}
.candelabra::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:16%;right:16%;bottom:-6px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%,rgba(0,0,0,.65),transparent 68%);filter:blur(3px);z-index:-1}
.candles{position:absolute;inset:0}
.candle{position:absolute;width:calc(9*var(--u));height:calc(var(--h)*var(--u));left:calc(var(--x)*var(--u));bottom:calc(var(--y)*var(--u));margin-left:calc(-4.5*var(--u));border-radius:calc(3*var(--u));background:repeating-linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(255,255,255,.95) 0 calc(1.6*var(--u)),rgba(212,203,188,.55) calc(1.6*var(--u)) calc(3.2*var(--u))),linear-gradient(90deg,#d6cebf,#f4ece0 30%,#fffdf8 50%,#ece4d5 70%,#cfc5b3)}
.candle::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-6%;right:-6%;top:-18%;height:24%;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 60%,rgba(255,255,255,.95),rgba(240,232,216,.55) 55%,rgba(200,190,170,.3))}
.c1{--x:47;--y:90;--h:56}
.c2{--x:79;--y:114;--h:68}
.c3{--x:110;--y:134;--h:82}
.c4{--x:141;--y:114;--h:68}
.c5{--x:173;--y:90;--h:56}
.wick{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:100%;width:calc(2*var(--u));height:calc(7*var(--u));margin-left:calc(-1*var(--u));background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5a4a35,#2a2018);border-radius:calc(1*var(--u))}
.flame{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:calc(100% + 5*var(--u));width:calc(22*var(--u));height:calc(34*var(--u));margin-left:calc(-11*var(--u));transform-origin:50% 100%;transform:scale(0);transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,1.8,.4,1)}
.flame .core{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50% 50% 50% 50%/62% 62% 38% 38%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 76%,#fffff0,#ffebb4 22%,#ffc88c 42%,#ffa0b4 62%,rgba(255,140,180,0) 82%);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 calc(10*var(--u)) rgba(255,200,120,.95)) drop-shadow(0 0 calc(24*var(--u)) rgba(255,160,120,.55));animation:flameFlick .16s infinite alternate}
.candle .flame.lit{transform:scale(1)}
.candle .flame.out{animation:flameOut .6s both}
@keyframes flameOut{0%{transform:scale(1)}30%{transform:scale(.72) translateX(2px) rotate(4deg)}100%{transform:scale(0)}}
#cake .candle-light{position:absolute;left:50%;top:52%;width:130%;height:100%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 58%,rgba(255,225,240,.26),rgba(255,150,200,.06) 52%,transparent 78%);filter:blur(12px);mix-blend-mode:screen;pointer-events:none;z-index:4;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1s}
#cake .candle-light.on{opacity:1}
.cake-stand,.cake-layer,.candelabra{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(28px);transition:opacity 1.1s,transform 1.2s}
.cake-layer .cyl-cap,.cake-layer .cyl-body,.cake-layer .cyl-texture{opacity:1}
#cake.show .cake-stand,#cake.show .cake-layer,#cake.show .candelabra{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
#cake.show .cake-stand{transition-delay:0s}
#cake.show .layer-bottom{transition-delay:.18s}
#cake.show .ring-bottom{transition-delay:.36s}
#cake.show .medallion-lg{transition-delay:.42s}
#cake.show .layer-top{transition-delay:.6s}
#cake.show .ring-top{transition-delay:.78s}
#cake.show .medallion-sm{transition-delay:.84s}
#cake.show .bow{transition-delay:.96s}
#cake.show .candelabra{transition-delay:1.1s}
.hud{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity 1.1s;z-index:20;padding-right:clamp(40px,10vw,140px)}
.hud.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.hud .card{display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:clamp(18px,3vw,40px);color:rgba(255,255,255,.92)}
.hud .card p{writing-mode:vertical-rl;text-orientation:upright;font-size:clamp(18px,3.6vw,26px);letter-spacing:.35em;line-height:1.6;font-weight:100;margin:0;order:2}
.hud .card .sub{writing-mode:vertical-rl;text-orientation:upright;font-size:clamp(12px,2.4vw,14px);letter-spacing:.3em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);margin:0 18px 0 0;order:2;font-weight:100}
.hud button{writing-mode:vertical-rl;text-orientation:upright;padding:28px 12px;font-size:16px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);background:transparent;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);font-weight:100;letter-spacing:.35em;order:1}
.sparkP{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 5px 1px #e6efff,0 0 10px 2px rgba(255,220,240,.55);pointer-events:none;z-index:25}
.pinkP{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#fff 0%,#ffe6f2 22%,#ffb8d8 52%,rgba(255,150,200,0) 84%);box-shadow:0 0 10px 2px rgba(255,180,220,.55);pointer-events:none;z-index:25;mix-blend-mode:screen}
.pinkP-soft{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,235,245,.85),rgba(255,155,205,.18) 62%,rgba(255,150,200,0) 82%);box-shadow:0 0 18px 6px rgba(255,170,210,.28);pointer-events:none;z-index:24;mix-blend-mode:screen;filter:blur(1.5px)}
.smokeP{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:25;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(190,190,200,.55),rgba(150,150,160,.22) 60%,transparent 75%)}

/* 最终文字页 */
.final-lines{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(22px,4.6vh,52px);z-index:3;padding:0 8vw;text-align:center}
.final-lines .line{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,220,240,.42);letter-spacing:.18em;line-height:1.9;font-family:'STKaiti','KaiTi',serif;font-size:clamp(18px,3.2vw,28px)}
.final-lines .line-1{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(13px,2vw,18px);letter-spacing:.46em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.68)}
.final-lines .line-4{color:rgba(255,238,222,.97);text-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(255,200,220,.55),0 0 52px rgba(230,170,255,.32)}
.scene.active .final-lines .line-1{animation:fIn 1.4s .5s both}
.scene.active .final-lines .line-2{animation:fIn 1.4s 1.8s both}
.scene.active .final-lines .line-3{animation:fIn 1.4s 3.2s both}
.scene.active .final-lines .line-4{animation:fIn 1.6s 4.6s both}
@keyframes fIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.final-lines .yellow-star{margin-top:clamp(6px,2.6vh,22px);width:clamp(38px,7.5vw,72px);opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.85);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(247,234,107,.65))}
.final-lines .yellow-star svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.scene.active .final-lines .yellow-star{animation:starPop 1.4s 6.2s cubic-bezier(.2,1.5,.4,1) both}
@keyframes starPop{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.6) rotate(-12deg)}60%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1.08) rotate(3deg)}100%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}
.final-tip{position:absolute;bottom:5vh;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:4px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity 1.4s;font-weight:200}
.scene.active .final-tip{opacity:1;transition-delay:7s}
.final-tip.ready{animation:tipReady 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes tipReady{0%,100%{opacity:.5}50%{opacity:1}}

/* 20颗星 */
.stars-wrap{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:2vmin}
.stars-svg{display:block;width:min(100vmin,100%);height:auto;overflow:visible;opacity:0;transform:scale(.96);transition:opacity 2s ease 1s,transform 2.2s ease 1s}
#scene-stars.active .stars-svg{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}
.stars-svg .star{fill:#e8b3c8;cursor:pointer;transition:fill .45s,filter .45s;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(232,179,200,.6));pointer-events:all}
.stars-svg .star:hover{fill:#fff0f6;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px #fff)}
.stars-svg .star.visited{fill:#f7ea6b;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px #fff2a0) drop-shadow(0 0 26px #f7ea6b)}
.star-counter{position:absolute;top:8vh;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:14px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);letter-spacing:4px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);padding:4px 16px;border-radius:20px;backdrop-filter:blur(4px);z-index:5}
.star-counter.hide{opacity:0}
#starGatherOverlay{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:29}
.gather-star{position:absolute;width:32px;height:32px;background:url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><polygon points="50,2 62,36 98,36 68,58 80,92 50,71 20,92 32,58 2,36 38,36" fill="%23f7ea6b"/></svg>') center/contain no-repeat;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px #f7ea6b);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:left 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), top 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 1.2s ease, opacity 1.2s}
.gather-star.blink{animation:blink 1s infinite alternate}
@keyframes blink{0%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:.4}}
/* 天蝎座：几个关键星画成空心圆，跟参考图一致 */
.gather-star.ring{background:none;border:2px solid #ffd9ea;border-radius:50%;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(255,180,215,.85))}
#starGatherOverlay .constellation{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible;opacity:0;animation:cFade 1.5s 1.1s both}
#starGatherOverlay .constellation line{stroke:rgba(228,216,255,.8);stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(200,180,255,.5))}
@keyframes cFade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
/* 文案整块压到下方，别和上方聚拢的星团抢位置 */
#starFinal{position:fixed;inset:0;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity 2s;z-index:28;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 38%,rgba(0,0,0,.1),rgba(0,0,0,.55) 72%);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:0 6vw clamp(44px,15vh,132px)}
#starFinal.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
#starFinal .text{font-family:'STKaiti','KaiTi',serif;font-size:clamp(18px,3.4vw,24px);color:#fff;letter-spacing:3px;text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,220,240,.6)}
#starFinal .park-tip{margin-top:clamp(18px,3.4vh,34px);font-family:'STKaiti','KaiTi',serif;font-size:clamp(12px,2vw,15px);letter-spacing:.26em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.62);opacity:0;transition:opacity 1s}
#starFinal .park-tip.show{opacity:1;animation:tipBreathe 2.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes tipBreathe{0%,100%{opacity:.55}50%{opacity:1}}
#starCard{position:fixed;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-48%) scale(.96);width:min(560px,84vw);padding:clamp(40px,6vh,64px) clamp(30px,5.5vw,60px) clamp(28px,4.5vh,44px);background:#faf3e8;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.75);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.55s;z-index:30}
#starCard.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1);pointer-events:auto}
#starCard .card-index{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:13px;color:#a89684;letter-spacing:5px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:clamp(30px,5vh,46px)}
#starCard .card-text{font-family:'STKaiti','KaiTi',serif;font-size:var(--cf,clamp(18px,3.8vw,25px));color:#3a3028;line-height:1.95;letter-spacing:2.5px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:clamp(32px,5.5vh,52px);white-space:nowrap}
#starCard .card-close{text-align:center;font-family:'STKaiti','KaiTi',serif;font-size:13px;color:#a89684;letter-spacing:6px;cursor:pointer}
/* =============================================================
   星光木语 · 生日信  |  附加场景样式：接电话
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   伞下心事那一幕的样式已经整体搬到 src/umbrella/umbrella3d.css，
   由 merge-birthday.ps1 在这里之后内联（替换掉旧版 gift3d.css 的位置）。
   这个文件现在只剩「3D 翻盖机接电话」这一幕。
   ============================================================= */
/* 透明底：让整页那层 canvas#sky 的黑色星空透进来，和前面几幕是同一片天。
   内嵌的 3D 机身那边也开了 alpha，穹顶不画，两边一叠加才是完整的星空。 */
#scene-call{background:transparent}
.call-stage{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}

/* ---- 3D 翻盖机（整份 MAGIC DUO 以 base64 内嵌，运行时 blob: URL） ---- */
.phone-wrap{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden}
.phone-frame{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;display:block;opacity:0;
  transition:opacity .8s ease}
.phone-frame.on{opacity:1}
/* 加载失败时才露出来的兜底 */
.phone-fallback{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);display:none;
  flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-align:center}
.phone-fallback b{font-family:'STKaiti','KaiTi',serif;font-size:clamp(15px,3vw,19px);letter-spacing:.16em;color:#ffd9ef}
.phone-fallback span{font-size:clamp(11px,2vw,13px);letter-spacing:.12em;color:rgba(255,214,238,.55)}
.phone-wrap.failed .phone-fallback{display:flex}
.phone-wrap.failed .call-tip{display:none}

/* 合盖来电：震动由 3D 场景里的机身自己做，父页不抖整幅画面 */
.call-closed{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;
  padding-bottom:clamp(26px,7vh,64px);gap:clamp(14px,2.4vh,22px);pointer-events:none;z-index:3}
.call-closed.on{display:flex}

.call-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55em;padding:.44em 1.15em;border-radius:999px;
  font-family:'STKaiti','KaiTi',serif;font-size:clamp(12px,2.3vw,15px);letter-spacing:.2em;color:#ffe6f7;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,190,226,.26),rgba(198,140,255,.20));
  border:1px solid rgba(255,206,235,.34);
  box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(20,4,30,.5),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  animation:badgePop .6s cubic-bezier(.2,1.2,.4,1) both}
.call-badge i{width:.52em;height:.52em;border-radius:50%;background:#ff9ecb;
  box-shadow:0 0 10px #ff9ecb;animation:badgeBlink 1.1s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes badgePop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px) scale(.9)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes badgeBlink{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:.35;transform:scale(.82)}}

.call-tip{font-family:'STKaiti','KaiTi',serif;font-size:clamp(13px,2.4vw,17px);letter-spacing:.2em;
  color:rgba(255,220,240,.78);animation:hintFloat 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;text-align:center;
  text-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(10,2,18,.9)}

/* 开盖来电：按钮分置在 3D 机身左右两侧的空档里，像来电界面那样。
   整层不吃点击，否则会把底下 3D 机身的「翻盖」交互挡掉。 */
.call-open{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:0 clamp(10px,5vw,54px);z-index:3;pointer-events:none}
.call-open.on{display:flex}
.call-open .call-actions{pointer-events:auto}

/* 手势提示卡：贴在 3D 机身底部那行状态文字的位置上（原来浮在机身中间，正好压住机身）。
   坐标由 3D 手机那边报过来（'hintslot'：它那行字的下沿离视口底边多少像素），
   下面的 bottom 是还没收到坐标时的兜底值。 */
.call-gesture{display:none;position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  bottom:51px;width:max-content;max-width:92vw;margin:0;padding:.52em 1.25em;border-radius:999px;
  font-size:clamp(10px,1.9vw,12.5px);letter-spacing:.16em;line-height:1.5;text-align:center;
  color:rgba(255,226,246,.74);background:rgba(0,0,0,.30);border:1px solid rgba(255,214,238,.16);
  backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
  text-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(10,2,18,.9)}
.call-gesture.on{display:block;animation:hintFloat 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}

/* 接听 / 拒接：撑满整行往两边推，避免叠在机身上 */
.call-actions{display:flex;width:100%;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.call-btn{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:7px;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;
  font-family:inherit;opacity:0;animation:rwIn .6s .5s both}
.call-btn i{width:clamp(48px,12vw,62px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:clamp(17px,4vw,22px);font-style:normal;color:#fff;transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.call-btn span{font-size:clamp(10px,2vw,12px);letter-spacing:.2em;color:rgba(255,220,240,.78)}
.call-ico{width:56%;height:56%;display:block}
.call-btn.decline i{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ff8a8a,#e0433f);box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(224,67,63,.42)}
.call-btn.accept i{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#7ce8a4,#28b866);box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(40,184,102,.42);
  animation:acceptPulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes acceptPulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(40,184,102,.42),0 0 0 0 rgba(40,184,102,.4)}
  50%{box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(40,184,102,.42),0 0 0 13px rgba(40,184,102,0)}}
.call-btn:hover i{transform:scale(1.1)}
.call-btn:active i{transform:scale(.94)}

/* 通话中：半透明罩在 3D 机身上，机身的光还透得出来 */
.call-talking{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;
  padding:clamp(30px,8vh,80px) 6vw;gap:clamp(8px,1.6vh,14px);z-index:4;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 46%,rgba(28,10,38,.80),rgba(4,1,8,.94));
  backdrop-filter:blur(9px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(9px)}
.call-talking.on{display:flex;animation:rwIn .7s both}
.talking-avatar{width:clamp(74px,19vw,108px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-family:'STKaiti','KaiTi',serif;font-size:clamp(30px,8vw,46px);color:#fff;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 36% 30%,#ffb3d6,#f266ab 58%,#cf3d86);
  box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(200,60,130,.4),0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
.talking-name{font-family:'STKaiti','KaiTi',serif;font-size:clamp(18px,4vw,26px);letter-spacing:.2em;color:#fff}
.talking-time{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(12px,2.4vw,16px);letter-spacing:.24em;color:rgba(255,200,225,.66)}
/* 消息多了、屏幕又矮的时候，这一块自己滚，底下那条「语音消息」才不会被裁掉。
   safe center：装得下就居中（老样子），装不下就顶到最上面，下面可以往下滚。
   min-height:0：不加的话 flex 子项不肯缩，滚动条不会出来。 */
.talking-msgs{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;justify-content:safe center;
  gap:clamp(8px,1.6vh,14px);width:100%;max-width:440px;margin-top:clamp(8px,2vh,18px);
  overflow-y:auto;scrollbar-width:thin}
.tmsg{max-width:86%;padding:11px 17px;border-radius:16px;font-family:'STKaiti','KaiTi',serif;
  font-size:clamp(12px,2.3vw,16px);line-height:1.8;letter-spacing:.08em;
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);animation:tmsgIn .7s cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.5,1) both}
@keyframes tmsgIn{to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.tmsg.them{align-self:flex-start;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);color:#4b3548;border-bottom-left-radius:5px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.32)}
.tmsg.me{align-self:flex-end;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#ff9dcb,#ec5aa4);color:#fff;border-bottom-right-radius:5px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(200,60,130,.3)}

/* 语音气泡：文字版说完之后，对方发来一条录好的原声。
   [▶] + 波形 + 时长；正在放的时候 ▶ 会跳一下，波形会动。 */
.tmsg.voice{align-self:flex-start;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:10px 16px 10px 12px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);color:#4b3548;border-bottom-left-radius:5px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.32)}
.voice-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;
  font-family:inherit;color:inherit}
.voice-ico{width:26px;height:26px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:10px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#ff9dcb,#ec5aa4);box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(200,60,130,.35)}
.tmsg.voice.playing .voice-ico{animation:voicePulse 1.1s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes voicePulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.14)}}
.voice-wave{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px;height:20px}
.voice-wave i{display:block;width:3px;height:6px;border-radius:2px;background:rgba(214,86,150,.72)}
.tmsg.voice.playing .voice-wave i{animation:voiceBar .9s ease-in-out infinite}
.voice-wave i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.12s}
.voice-wave i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.24s}
.voice-wave i:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.36s}
.voice-wave i:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.48s}
@keyframes voiceBar{0%,100%{height:6px}50%{height:19px}}
.voice-len{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:rgba(90,60,85,.72);min-width:26px}
/* 气泡右边那句小字：平时「语音消息」，被浏览器挡住自动播的时候改成「点一下听」 */
.voice-hint{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:rgba(90,60,85,.55);white-space:nowrap}
.tmsg.voice.need-tap .voice-hint{color:#d1308c;font-weight:600}
/* 自动播被浏览器挡了：▶ 外面套一圈提示，让人知道要点一下 */
.tmsg.voice.need-tap .voice-ico{animation:voiceRing 1.5s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes voiceRing{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(236,90,164,.55)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 11px rgba(236,90,164,0)}
  100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(236,90,164,0)}}
.talking-hangup{margin-top:clamp(12px,3vh,26px);padding:11px 34px;border-radius:999px;border:0;cursor:pointer;
  font-family:inherit;font-size:clamp(12px,1.9vw,14px);letter-spacing:.3em;color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ff8a8a,#d93b37);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(217,59,55,.4);
  transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.talking-hangup:hover{transform:scale(1.06);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(217,59,55,.5)}

/* 结束语 */
.call-end{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  gap:clamp(18px,3.6vh,34px);text-align:center;padding:0 8vw;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 46%,rgba(30,12,36,.97),rgba(3,1,6,.995));
  backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity 1.3s ease,visibility 1.3s}
.call-end.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.call-end-line{font-family:'STKaiti','KaiTi',serif;font-size:clamp(17px,3.4vw,27px);line-height:2.1;letter-spacing:.2em;
  color:#fff;text-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(255,190,225,.55);opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)}
.call-end.show .call-end-line{animation:endIn 1.6s both}
@keyframes endIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.call-end-replay{margin-top:clamp(6px,2vh,16px);padding:11px 28px;border-radius:999px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,205,232,.3);background:rgba(30,20,36,.5);color:rgba(255,236,246,.9);
  font-family:inherit;font-size:clamp(11px,1.8vw,13px);letter-spacing:.24em;cursor:pointer;
  opacity:0;animation:endIn 1.2s 3s both;transition:background .4s}
.call-end-replay:hover{background:rgba(255,190,225,.15)}
/* 「从头再来一遍」：比上面那颗低调一档，放第二行 */
.call-end-again{margin-top:0;padding:10px 26px;border-radius:999px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,205,232,.18);background:transparent;color:rgba(255,226,240,.6);
  font-family:inherit;font-size:clamp(10px,1.7vw,12px);letter-spacing:.24em;cursor:pointer;
  opacity:0;animation:endIn 1.2s 3.3s both;transition:background .4s,color .4s,border-color .4s}
.call-end-again:hover{border-color:rgba(255,190,225,.42);background:rgba(255,190,225,.1);color:rgba(255,240,248,.95)}

/* ---- 双击打开（file://）时的提示条：摄像头没权限，给一条能点的出路 ---- */
/* z-index 要压过 .call-end(50) 和 #loading(60)：
   通话结束那层是整屏不透明的遮罩，层级比它低的话横幅就「在 DOM 里但看不见」。 */
.serve-hint{position:fixed;left:14px;top:14px;z-index:90;width:min(360px,86vw);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:13px 15px;border-radius:14px;text-align:left;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(40,14,46,.93),rgba(18,6,26,.95));
  border:1px solid rgba(255,180,220,.34);
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.55);animation:serveIn .6s .35s both}
@keyframes serveIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.serve-hint b{font-family:'STKaiti','KaiTi',serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em;
  color:#ffd9ef;font-weight:600;padding-right:22px}
.serve-hint span{display:block;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.7;color:rgba(255,224,244,.74)}
.serve-hint-go{display:block;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:10px;text-decoration:none;word-break:break-all;
  font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.02em;color:#2a0f22;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,#ffc2e2,#ff9ecb);box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(255,158,203,.32);
  transition:filter .2s}
.serve-hint-go:hover{filter:brightness(1.07)}
.serve-hint-tip{font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.65;color:rgba(255,214,238,.52)}
.serve-hint-x{position:absolute;right:8px;top:7px;width:22px;height:22px;border:0;border-radius:50%;
  background:transparent;color:rgba(255,220,240,.6);font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;line-height:1;
  font-family:inherit}
.serve-hint-x:hover{background:rgba(255,190,225,.16);color:#fff}

@media (max-width:520px){
  .gift-stage{padding-bottom:clamp(152px,23vh,200px)}
}

/* =============================================================
   背景音乐 · Sweet (feat. Landon Sears) — Bren Joy / Landon Sears
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   一个小小的 ♪ 开关，固定在左上角 —— 整封信的每一幕都在，
   不会挡到任何控件（密码门 / 星图 / 游乐园 / 翻盖机都空着左上角）。
   没开始放的时候音符会轻轻呼吸，提示「这里可以点」；
   放起来了就常亮；被手动关掉时划一道斜杠。
   ============================================================= */
#bgmBtn{position:fixed;left:clamp(10px,2.2vw,22px);top:clamp(10px,2.2vw,22px);z-index:60;
  width:clamp(32px,4.2vw,38px);height:clamp(32px,4.2vw,38px);border-radius:50%;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0;margin:0;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,205,232,.24);background:rgba(22,14,28,.44);
  color:rgba(255,226,240,.78);font-size:clamp(14px,1.9vw,16px);line-height:1;
  font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;
  backdrop-filter:blur(7px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(7px);
  transition:opacity .5s,transform .35s,background .35s,border-color .35s,color .35s}
#bgmBtn.idle{opacity:.5;animation:bgmBreathe 2.9s ease-in-out infinite}
#bgmBtn.on{opacity:1;background:rgba(255,190,225,.13);border-color:rgba(255,205,232,.5);color:#fff}
#bgmBtn.off{opacity:.4;color:rgba(255,226,240,.42);border-color:rgba(255,205,232,.13)}
#bgmBtn:hover{opacity:1;background:rgba(255,190,225,.18);border-color:rgba(255,205,232,.62);color:#fff}
#bgmBtn.off:hover{opacity:.72}
#bgmBtn:active{transform:scale(.92)}
@keyframes bgmBreathe{0%,100%{opacity:.44}50%{opacity:.92}}
/* 静音斜杠：position:fixed 的父级就是 ::after 的包含块 */
#bgmBtn.off::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:58%;height:1.5px;
  background:rgba(255,150,180,.92);border-radius:2px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-45deg)}

/* 提示条：自动播放被拦、或者刚开播时认一下这首歌 */
#bgmHint{position:fixed;left:clamp(10px,2.2vw,22px);
  top:calc(clamp(10px,2.2vw,22px) + clamp(32px,4.2vw,38px) + 9px);z-index:60;
  padding:7px 14px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none;
  background:rgba(20,12,26,.82);border:1px solid rgba(255,205,232,.22);
  color:rgba(255,226,240,.88);font-size:clamp(11px,1.7vw,12.5px);letter-spacing:.1em;
  font-family:inherit;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-6px);
  transition:opacity .45s,transform .45s}
#bgmHint.show{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* ============================================================
   游乐园（20 颗星之后）
   ============================================================ */
#scene-park{background:transparent}
.park-stage{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden}
#parkFrame{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;display:block;background:#05030a;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.6s cubic-bezier(.45,.05,.35,1)}
#parkFrame.on{opacity:1}
.park-vignette{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 46%,transparent 44%,rgba(3,2,8,.46) 94%)}
/* 开场幕透出整页的星空底：只压一层暗角，不能糊成一块死黑 */
.park-intro{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:6;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(14px,2.4vh,26px);padding:0 8vw;text-align:center;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 48%,rgba(5,3,11,.52),rgba(2,1,6,.88));transition:opacity 1.3s ease,visibility 1.3s}
.park-intro.hide{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.park-kicker{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(10px,1.6vw,13px);letter-spacing:.52em;text-indent:.52em;color:rgba(255,214,236,.6);opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}
.park-title{margin:0;font-family:'STKaiti','KaiTi',serif;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(24px,5.2vw,44px);letter-spacing:.2em;text-indent:.2em;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(255,190,225,.6);opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}
.park-sub{margin:0;font-family:'STKaiti','KaiTi',serif;font-size:clamp(14px,2.5vw,19px);line-height:2.1;letter-spacing:.16em;color:rgba(255,238,246,.82);opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}
.park-enter{margin-top:clamp(8px,1.6vh,18px);padding:11px 30px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(255,205,232,.34);background:rgba(28,18,34,.42);color:#fce8f0;font-family:inherit;font-size:clamp(12px,1.9vw,15px);letter-spacing:.3em;cursor:pointer;opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px);transition:background .5s,border-color .5s,box-shadow .5s}
.park-enter:hover{background:rgba(255,190,225,.14);border-color:rgba(255,205,232,.7);box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(255,180,220,.34)}
#scene-park.active .park-kicker{animation:pIn 1.1s .35s both}
#scene-park.active .park-title{animation:pIn 1.3s .7s both}
#scene-park.active .park-sub{animation:pIn 1.3s 1.15s both}
#scene-park.active .park-enter{animation:pIn 1.2s 1.75s both}
@keyframes pIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.park-nav{position:absolute;left:clamp(10px,2.2vw,28px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:7;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px}
.park-nav button{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .9s,visibility .9s,background .45s,border-color .45s,transform .25s;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.park-nav button.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.park-nav button:hover{background:rgba(255,190,225,.14);border-color:rgba(255,205,232,.6)}
.park-nav button:active{transform:scale(.96)}
.park-next{padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(255,205,232,.26);background:rgba(20,14,26,.5);color:rgba(255,236,246,.86);font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.park-next{border-color:rgba(255,214,160,.34);color:rgba(255,240,214,.92);background:rgba(38,22,14,.5)}
.park-next:hover{border-color:rgba(255,214,160,.72)!important;background:rgba(255,200,130,.14)!important}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<canvas id="sky"></canvas>

<!-- 密码 -->
<section id="scene-pass" class="scene active">
  <div class="pw-stage" id="pwStage">
    <h1 class="pw-title">给尤家瑜的一封生日信</h1>
    <div class="pw-line">
      <span class="pw-label">JIA</span>
      <div class="pw-boxes" id="pwBoxes"></div>
      <span class="pw-label">Ten 26</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="pw-hint">输入密码 you，开启你的生日惊喜</div>
</section>
<input id="pwInput" autocomplete="off" maxlength="3">

<!-- 信纸 -->
<section id="scene-letter" class="scene">
  <div class="letter-stage">
    <div class="scroll-wrap" id="scrollWrap">
      <div class="roller roller-top">
        <div class="roller-cap roller-cap-l"></div><div class="roller-cap roller-cap-r"></div><div class="roller-body"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="paper-viewport" id="paperViewport">
        <div class="paper-surface" id="paperSurface">
          <div class="paper-content">
            <p class="paper-orn">❀ ✿ ❀</p>
            <h2 class="letter-title">To：家瑜</h2>
            <p class="letter-greet">生日快乐呀！又一年</p>
            <p class="letter-p">只希望你做自己想做的事少忧愁，</p>
            <p class="letter-p">一直在自己热爱的生活里奔跑平安喜乐，</p>
            <p class="letter-p">永远伴随着你不止生日快乐，</p>
            <p class="letter-p">希望你每一天都快乐！</p>
            <p class="letter-p letter-p-gap">不知道该送你一份怎么样的礼物。</p>
            <p class="letter-p">第一次做可能比较简陋不是很完善，</p>
            <p class="letter-p">希望你能喜欢哦！</p>
            <p class="letter-sign">婷</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="roller roller-bottom" id="rollerBottom">
        <div class="roll-bundle" id="rollBundle"></div>
        <div class="roller-cap roller-cap-l"></div><div class="roller-cap roller-cap-r"></div><div class="roller-body"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <button class="roll-btn" id="rollBtn">读完啦 · 点击屏幕卷起信封 ✨</button>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 卷轴 -->
<section id="scene-scroll" class="scene">
  <div class="scroll-wrap2" id="scrollRoll">
    <svg class="scroll-svg" viewBox="0 0 200 430">
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id="scTube" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#cdbb99"/><stop offset=".14" stop-color="#efe3c9"/><stop offset=".4" stop-color="#fdf8ec"/><stop offset=".66" stop-color="#f2e8d2"/><stop offset=".86" stop-color="#d5c6a6"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#b09d78"/></linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id="scCap" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#6b4529"/><stop offset=".45" stop-color="#4e3120"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#33200f"/></linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id="scRibbon" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#f9ccd7"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#f2b3c4"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#e79cb1"/></linearGradient>
      </defs>
      <rect x="52" y="62" width="96" height="310" rx="12" fill="url(#scTube)"/>
      <rect x="130" y="66" width="12" height="302" rx="5" fill="rgba(255,252,243,.5)"/>
      <path d="M130 62 L130 372" stroke="rgba(120,100,70,.4)" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <ellipse cx="100" cy="66" rx="46" ry="12" fill="#4a2e18"/>
      <rect x="56" y="36" width="88" height="32" rx="13" fill="url(#scCap)"/>
      <ellipse cx="100" cy="36" rx="44" ry="12" fill="#33200f"/>
      <ellipse cx="100" cy="364" rx="46" ry="12" fill="#4a2e18"/>
      <rect x="56" y="362" width="88" height="32" rx="13" fill="url(#scCap)"/>
      <ellipse cx="100" cy="394" rx="44" ry="12" fill="#33200f"/>
      <path d="M52 206 Q100 216 148 206" fill="none" stroke="url(#scRibbon)" stroke-width="14"/>
      <path d="M52 224 Q100 234 148 224" fill="none" stroke="url(#scRibbon)" stroke-width="14"/>
      <path d="M94 222C88 254 84 288 76 320" fill="none" stroke="url(#scRibbon)" stroke-width="13"/>
      <path d="M106 222C112 254 116 288 124 320" fill="none" stroke="url(#scRibbon)" stroke-width="13"/>
      <path d="M97 210C82 186 60 178 51 190C42 202 54 219 73 219C86 219 93 214 97 211" fill="none" stroke="url(#scRibbon)" stroke-width="12.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M103 210C118 186 140 178 149 190C158 202 146 219 127 219C114 219 107 214 103 211" fill="none" stroke="url(#scRibbon)" stroke-width="12.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <ellipse cx="100" cy="213" rx="10" ry="8.5" fill="#e28ea5"/>
    </svg>
    <div class="scroll-tip">点一点卷轴 ✨</div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 火柴蛋糕 -->
<section id="scene-match" class="scene">
  <div id="lightPool"></div>
  <div class="matchbox" id="matchbox">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 260 320">
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id="mbTop" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fcf2de"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#f4e6cb"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#e8d4b2"/></linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id="mbFront" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#f7e9ce"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#efdcbb"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#dfc9a3"/></linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id="mbSide" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#dcc5a0"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#b89a70"/></linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id="mbStrip" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#3a322b"/><stop offset=".35" stop-color="#181410"/><stop offset=".72" stop-color="#221c17"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#0e0b08"/></linearGradient>
        <radialGradient id="mbSky" cx="50%" cy="42%" r="62%"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#2e3763"/><stop offset=".6" stop-color="#171c34"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#0a0d1c"/></radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id="mbGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%"><stop offset="0" stop-color="rgba(255,222,150,.95)"/><stop offset=".42" stop-color="rgba(255,170,70,.4)"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="rgba(255,150,50,0)"/></radialGradient>
        <linearGradient id="mbHat" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#e8503f"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#9c2a22"/></linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id="mbCloak" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#7a8868"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#3a4230"/></linearGradient>
        <clipPath id="mbClipOval"><ellipse cx="120" cy="196" rx="62" ry="72"/></clipPath>
      </defs>
      <path d="M30 52 L56 30 L226 30 L200 52 Z" fill="url(#mbTop)"/>
      <path d="M200 52 L226 30 L226 268 L200 290 Z" fill="url(#mbSide)"/>
      <rect x="30" y="52" width="170" height="238" fill="url(#mbFront)"/>
      <text x="115" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Georgia,serif" font-size="34" font-weight="700" fill="#8e2a22">MATCH</text>
      <ellipse cx="120" cy="196" rx="62" ry="72" fill="url(#mbSky)"/>
      <g clip-path="url(#mbClipOval)">
        <circle cx="154" cy="196" r="42" fill="url(#mbGlow)"/>
        <path d="M88 248 C84 226 92 208 104 204 C109 218 109 234 104 248 Z" fill="#7d8a6a"/>
        <path d="M100 248 C96 222 106 204 118 200 C132 196 144 206 146 224 C148 238 142 246 136 250 Z" fill="url(#mbCloak)"/>
        <ellipse cx="112" cy="248" rx="12" ry="6" fill="#3a3226"/>
        <ellipse cx="138" cy="250" rx="12" ry="6" fill="#3a3226"/>
        <path d="M108 216 C108 202 116 194 126 194 C138 194 144 204 142 216 C140 229 132 235 124 235 C115 235 109 229 108 216 Z" fill="#f7f1e3"/>
        <circle cx="126" cy="208" r="7.2" fill="#f0c9a3"/>
        <path d="M108 202 C110 180 120 162 127 156 C134 167 142 182 144 202 C132 208 118 208 108 202 Z" fill="url(#mbHat)"/>
        <circle cx="127" cy="154" r="6.5" fill="#fbf6ea"/>
        <circle cx="143" cy="218" r="5" fill="#f0c9a3"/>
        <path d="M145 218 L156 176" stroke="#e8d9b8" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <path d="M156 174 C151 162 158 154 159 146 C168 154 170 164 163 174 C160 178 158 177 156 174 Z" fill="#ffb347"/>
      </g>
      <ellipse cx="120" cy="196" rx="62" ry="72" fill="none" stroke="#8e2a22" stroke-width="4"/>
      <path d="M204 54 L224 34 L224 266 L204 286 Z" fill="url(#mbStrip)"/>
    </svg>
    <div class="strike-strip" id="strikeStrip"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="strike-hint" id="strikeHint">按住火柴，在右侧磨砂条上上下划一划 🔥</div>
  <div id="match">
    <div class="match-flame" id="matchFlame"><i class="core"></i></div>
    <div class="match-head"></div>
    <div class="match-stick"></div>
  </div>
  <div id="cake">
    <div class="candle-light" id="candleLight"></div>
    <div class="cake-stand"><div class="stand-disc"></div><div class="stand-slate"></div></div>
    <div class="cake-layer layer-bottom">
      <div class="cyl"><div class="cyl-cap"></div><div class="cyl-body"><div class="cyl-texture"></div></div></div>
      <div class="ring-pearls ring-bottom"></div>
      <svg class="medallion medallion-lg" viewBox="0 0 100 124">
        <defs>
          <radialGradient id="camBgD" cx="42%" cy="28%" r="82%"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#f8dfe3"/><stop offset=".42" stop-color="#eabfcb"/><stop offset=".78" stop-color="#cb93a2"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#a86f80"/></radialGradient>
          <linearGradient id="camIvory" x1="0.15" y1="0" x2="0.85" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fffdf4"/><stop offset=".32" stop-color="#f8ead8"/><stop offset=".62" stop-color="#e9d2b8"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#c8a68a"/></linearGradient>
          <linearGradient id="camHairD" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#f4d2db"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#b87a8e"/></linearGradient>
          <clipPath id="camClipD"><ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="36" ry="49"/></clipPath>
        </defs>
        <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="36" ry="49" fill="url(#camBgD)"/>
        <g clip-path="url(#camClipD)">
          <path d="M50 16.5C60 16.5 68.5 23 70.5 33.5C71.5 37.5 72 40.5 72 43.5C72 46.5 70.8 48 70.8 49.5C70.8 52 75.2 54.5 76.8 56.5C78.4 58.5 74.2 59.6 71.2 60.2C70.6 61 70.9 62 71.3 63C73.2 63.6 73.2 65.2 71.2 66.2C70.6 67.2 71.2 68.2 71.2 69.8C71.2 73 68.2 76 64.6 78C60 80.4 57.2 83.4 56.2 88.2L55.6 93C62 93 68.5 95 74.5 99.5C80.5 104 85 111 87 119L14 119C16 108 21 99 28 92C33 87 30 82 26 76C21.5 69 19.5 58 20.5 47C22 30 34 16.5 50 16.5Z" fill="url(#camIvory)"/>
          <path d="M50 16.5C35 17 23.5 29 21.5 46C20 60 24 74 31 84C35 90 41 92 45 88C40 79 37.5 68 40.5 57C43 47 48 37.5 56 30C59.5 26.5 58 19 50 16.5Z" fill="url(#camHairD)"/>
          <g fill="url(#camHairD)"><circle cx="24" cy="42" r="4.8"/><circle cx="23" cy="52" r="4.2"/><circle cx="25" cy="62" r="4.4"/><circle cx="29" cy="72" r="4.2"/><circle cx="34" cy="80" r="3.8"/><circle cx="41" cy="86" r="3.4"/></g>
        </g>
        <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="40.5" ry="53.5" fill="none" stroke="#fdfcf8" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="0.1 12.5"/>
      </svg>
    </div>
    <div class="cake-layer layer-top">
      <div class="cyl"><div class="cyl-cap"></div><div class="cyl-body"><div class="cyl-texture"></div></div></div>
      <div class="ring-pearls ring-top"></div>
      <svg class="medallion medallion-sm" viewBox="0 0 100 124">
        <defs>
          <radialGradient id="camBgW" cx="42%" cy="28%" r="82%"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fefaf2"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#f2e6d4"/><stop offset=".82" stop-color="#d6c4ae"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#b8a68e"/></radialGradient>
          <linearGradient id="camIvoryW" x1="0.15" y1="0" x2="0.85" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffffff"/><stop offset=".32" stop-color="#fbf4e4"/><stop offset=".62" stop-color="#eee2cb"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#cabda8"/></linearGradient>
          <linearGradient id="camHairW" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#f6e5d9"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#bda594"/></linearGradient>
          <clipPath id="camClipW"><ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="36" ry="49"/></clipPath>
        </defs>
        <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="36" ry="49" fill="url(#camBgW)"/>
        <g clip-path="url(#camClipW)">
