<!-- ============ 接电话（3D 翻盖机） ============ -->
<section id="scene-call" class="scene">
  <div class="call-stage">

    <!-- 3D 翻盖机：整份 MAGIC DUO 以 base64 内嵌，运行时用 blob: URL 塞进 iframe，
         所以整封信仍然是 ONE 个自包含 html，file:// 双击可开；
         blob 继承父页 origin，摄像头 / 手势模型才拿得到
         （data: 的 origin 不透明，iframe 里压根没有 navigator.mediaDevices） -->
    <div class="phone-wrap" id="phoneWrap">
      <iframe class="phone-frame" id="phoneFrame" title="MAGIC DUO · 玫粉复古翻盖机" scrolling="no"></iframe>
      <div class="phone-fallback" id="phoneFallback">
        <b>3D 机身没能打开</b>
        <span>换一个浏览器再试一次就好啦</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 合盖：震动 + 来电 -->
    <div class="call-closed" id="callClosed">
      <div class="call-badge" id="callBadge"><i></i>婷 有来电</div>
      <div class="call-tip" id="callTip">手机在震动 · 点一下接过来 ✦</div>
    </div>

    <!-- 开盖来电：机身主屏已经写着「婷来电」，这里只留操作按钮 -->
    <div class="call-open" id="callOpen">
      <div class="call-actions">
        <button class="call-btn decline" id="callDecline" type="button"><i>✕</i><span>先不接</span></button>
        <button class="call-btn accept" id="callAccept" type="button"><i><svg class="call-ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="currentColor" d="M7.4 3.2c.8-.2 1.6.3 1.9 1.1l1.1 3c.2.6 0 1.3-.5 1.7l-1.7 1.4a13.3 13.3 0 0 0 5.4 5.4l1.4-1.7c.4-.5 1.1-.7 1.7-.5l3 1.1c.8.3 1.3 1.1 1.1 1.9l-.5 2.3c-.2.9-1 1.5-1.9 1.5C10.1 20.3 3.7 13.9 3.7 5.7c0-.9.6-1.7 1.5-1.9l2.2-.6Z"/></svg></i><span>接听</span></button>
      </div>
      <!-- 手势提示：只有 3D 手机那边真的把摄像头开起来了才露出来 -->
      <div class="call-gesture" id="callGesture">✋ 张开五指 = 接听 · 握拳 = 先不接 · 捏合 CALL 键 = 接听</div>
    </div>

    <!-- 通话中 -->
    <div class="call-talking" id="callTalking">
      <div class="talking-avatar">婷</div>
      <div class="talking-name">婷</div>
      <div class="talking-time" id="talkingTime">00:00</div>
      <div class="talking-msgs" id="talkingMsgs"></div>
      <div class="talking-hangup" id="talkingHangup">挂 断</div>
    </div>

  </div>
</section>

<!-- 游乐园（20 颗星之后） -->
<section id="scene-park" class="scene">
  <div class="park-stage">
    <iframe id="parkFrame" title="游乐园" scrolling="no"></iframe>
    <div class="park-vignette"></div>
    <div class="park-nav">
      <button class="park-next" id="parkNext" type="button">下一幕 · 接电话 ☎</button>
    </div>
    <div class="park-intro" id="parkIntro">
      <div class="park-kicker">HAPPY BIRTHDAY</div>
      <h2 class="park-title">游乐园</h2>
      <p class="park-sub">二十颗星，是二十年的光。<br>这座游乐园，是我想和你一起去的地方。</p>
      <button class="park-enter" id="parkEnter" type="button">推 门 进 去 ✦</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
'use strict';
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));
const lerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;
const easeIO=t=>t<.5?2*t*t:1-Math.pow(-2*t+2,2)/2;
const easeOut=t=>1-Math.pow(1-t,3);
const easeIn=t=>t*t;
const easeInOutSine=t=>0.5-0.5*Math.cos(Math.PI*t);

/* 音频 */
let actx=null;
function AC(){if(!actx){const C=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!C)return null;actx=new C();}if(actx.state==='suspended')actx.resume();return actx;}
function tone(f,dur,o){const ctx=AC();if(!ctx)return;o=o||{};const t0=ctx.currentTime+(o.when||0);const osc=ctx.createOscillator();osc.type=o.type||'sine';osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,t0);if(o.slide)osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(30,f+o.slide),t0+dur);const g=ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t0);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(o.gain||.12,t0+(o.attack||.01));g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t0+dur);osc.connect(g);g.connect(ctx.destination);osc.start(t0);osc.stop(t0+dur+.05);}
function noise(o){const ctx=AC();if(!ctx)return;o=o||{};const t0=ctx.currentTime+(o.when||0);const dur=o.dur||.3;const len=Math.max(1,Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*dur));const buf=ctx.createBuffer(1,len,ctx.sampleRate);const d=buf.getChannelData(0);for(let i=0;i<len;i++)d[i]=Math.random()*2-1;const src=ctx.createBufferSource();src.buffer=buf;const f=ctx.createBiquadFilter();f.type=o.type||'bandpass';f.frequency.value=o.freq||1000;f.Q.value=o.q||1;const g=ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t0);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(o.gain||.15,t0+Math.min(.02,dur*.3));g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t0+dur);src.connect(f);f.connect(g);g.connect(ctx.destination);src.start(t0);}
function sndStrike(){noise({dur:.18,type:'highpass',freq:2800,q:.8,gain:.35});}
function sndScrape(){noise({dur:.11,type:'highpass',freq:2400,q:.7,gain:.13});}
function sndIgnite(){noise({dur:.5,type:'lowpass',freq:480,q:.6,gain:.22});}
function sndCandlePop(){tone(760,.09,{gain:.1,slide:1500});}
function sndChime(){[523.25,659.25,783.99,1046.5].forEach((f,i)=>tone(f,.5,{gain:.12,when:i*.09}));}
function sndPaper(){noise({dur:1.1,type:'lowpass',freq:560,q:.7,gain:.11});}
function sndBlow(){noise({dur:.7,type:'bandpass',freq:700,q:.5,gain:.3});}
function sndMelody(){const N={G4:392,A4:440,B4:493.88,C5:523.25,D5:587.33,E5:659.25,F5:698.46,G5:783.99};const seq=[['G4',.5],['G4',.5],['A4',1],['G4',1],['C5',1],['B4',2],['G4',.5],['G4',.5],['A4',1],['G4',1],['D5',1],['C5',2],['G4',.5],['G4',.5],['G5',1],['E5',1],['C5',1],['B4',1],['A4',2],['F5',.5],['F5',.5],['E5',1],['C5',1],['D5',1],['C5',2]];let t=.15;seq.forEach(p=>{tone(N[p[0]],p[1]*.92,{type:'triangle',gain:.14,when:t,attack:.02});t+=p[1];});}

/* 星空 */
const sky=$('#sky'),sctx=sky.getContext('2d');
let W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight,starsDeep=[],starsMid=[],meteors=[],nextMeteorAt=1600,lastSkyNow=0;
const skyStart=performance.now();
function makeStars(){W=innerWidth;H=innerHeight;sky.width=W;sky.height=H;
  starsDeep=[];for(let i=0;i<Math.min(360,Math.max(140,Math.floor(W*H/9000)));i++)starsDeep.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,r:0.25+Math.random()*0.55,phase:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,period:2+Math.random(),baseA:0.14+Math.random()*0.22,hue:Math.random()<0.72?'200,210,230':'220,200,235'});
  starsMid=[];for(let i=0;i<Math.min(140,Math.max(60,Math.floor(W*H/26000)));i++)starsMid.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,r:0.7+Math.random()*1.1,phase:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,period:2+Math.random(),baseA:0.3+Math.random()*0.35,hue:Math.random()<0.6?'255,235,220':'255,220,240'});
}
makeStars();
window.addEventListener('resize',makeStars);
function spawnMeteor(){const rad=30*Math.PI/180;const dirX=Math.cos(rad),dirY=Math.sin(rad);const startX=W*0.08+Math.random()*W*0.72;const startY=-H*0.12+Math.random()*H*0.3;const totalDist=W*1.1+Math.random()*W*0.5;const trailLen=W*(0.25+Math.random()*0.08);meteors.push({startX,startY,dirX,dirY,totalDist,duration:(1.2+Math.random()*0.6)*1000,elapsed:0,trailFrac:trailLen/totalDist,fadeOut:0,hue:320+Math.random()*30,ended:false});}
function drawSky(now){const t=(now-skyStart)/1000;sctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);sctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  const deepFade=Math.min(1,t);const midFade=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(t-0.2)/0.8));
  for(const s of starsDeep){const wave=0.5+0.5*Math.sin((t/s.period+s.phase)*Math.PI*2);const a=s.baseA*(0.45+0.55*wave)*deepFade;if(a<=0.002)continue;sctx.fillStyle=`rgba(${s.hue}, ${a})`;sctx.beginPath();sctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,6.2832);sctx.fill();}
  for(const s of starsMid){const wave=0.5+0.5*Math.sin((t/s.period+s.phase)*Math.PI*2);const a=(0.3+0.55*wave)*midFade;if(a<=0.005)continue;const g=sctx.createRadialGradient(s.x,s.y,0,s.x,s.y,s.r*4);g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(${s.hue}, ${a})`);g.addColorStop(1,`rgba(${s.hue}, 0)`);sctx.fillStyle=g;sctx.beginPath();sctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r*4,0,6.2832);sctx.fill();}
  const dt=Math.min(50,now-lastSkyNow);lastSkyNow=now;
  if(now>=nextMeteorAt){spawnMeteor();nextMeteorAt=now+3500;}
  for(let i=meteors.length-1;i>=0;i--){const m=meteors[i];
    if(!m.ended){m.elapsed+=dt;if(m.elapsed>=m.duration){m.elapsed=m.duration;m.ended=true;}}else{m.fadeOut+=dt;if(m.fadeOut>500){meteors.splice(i,1);continue;}}
    const prog=m.elapsed/m.duration;const eased=easeInOutSine(Math.min(1,prog));
    const headX=m.startX+m.dirX*m.totalDist*eased;const headY=m.startY+m.dirY*m.totalDist*eased;
    const tail=eased-Math.min(eased,m.trailFrac);const tailX=m.startX+m.dirX*m.totalDist*tail;const tailY=m.startY+m.dirY*m.totalDist*tail;
    /* 出生就让光晕淡入，否则整颗流星会在画面左上角糊出一团紫光 */
    const fadeA=(m.ended?Math.max(0,1-m.fadeOut/500):1)*Math.min(1,prog/0.25);
    if(headX<-160||headX>W+160||headY>H+160){meteors.splice(i,1);continue;}
    sctx.lineCap='round';
    for(let s=0;s<26;s++){const p0=s/26,p1=(s+1)/26;const x0=tailX+(headX-tailX)*p0;const y0=tailY+(headY-tailY)*p0;const x1=tailX+(headX-tailX)*p1;const y1=tailY+(headY-tailY)*p1;const a0=Math.pow(p0,1.6)*0.72*fadeA;sctx.strokeStyle=`hsla(${m.hue+(1-p0)*22}, 68%, ${62+p0*28}%, ${a0})`;sctx.lineWidth=0.9+p1*4.6;sctx.beginPath();sctx.moveTo(x0,y0);sctx.lineTo(x1,y1);sctx.stroke();}
    const hg=sctx.createRadialGradient(headX,headY,0,headX,headY,15);hg.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,255,255,${0.95*fadeA})`);hg.addColorStop(0.3,`rgba(255,228,245,${0.6*fadeA})`);hg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,200,230,0)');sctx.fillStyle=hg;sctx.beginPath();sctx.arc(headX,headY,15,0,6.2832);sctx.fill();
  }
  sctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
}
function skyLoop(now){drawSky(now);requestAnimationFrame(skyLoop);}
requestAnimationFrame(skyLoop);

/* 场景管理 */
const scenes=[...document.querySelectorAll('.scene')];
let curScene='scene-pass';
function showScene(el){scenes.forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));el.classList.add('active');curScene=el.id;}

/* 密码 */
const PW='you';
let typed='',pwState='idle';
const pwStage=$('#pwStage'),pwBoxesEl=$('#pwBoxes'),pwInput=$('#pwInput');
pwBoxesEl.innerHTML='<div class="pw-box"></div>'.repeat(3);
const boxes=[...pwBoxesEl.querySelectorAll('.pw-box')];
boxes.forEach((b,i)=>{setTimeout(()=>{if(b.dataset.activated)return;b.dataset.activated='1';b.classList.add('activated');},3200+i*300);});
function renderBoxes(){boxes.forEach((b,i)=>{b.textContent=typed[i]?typed[i].toUpperCase():'';b.classList.toggle('filled',!!typed[i]);});}
function onChar(ch){if(pwState!=='idle'||typed.length>=PW.length)return;typed+=ch.toLowerCase();renderBoxes();if(typed.length===PW.length){pwState=typed===PW?'ok':'wrong';if(pwState==='ok')pwSuccess();else pwFail();}}
function pwFail(){pwStage.classList.add('shake');boxes.forEach(b=>b.classList.add('wrong'));setTimeout(()=>{typed='';pwInput.value='';pwStage.classList.remove('shake');boxes.forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('wrong'));renderBoxes();pwState='idle';},700);}
function pwSuccess(){pwStage.classList.add('ok');pwInput.value='';setTimeout(()=>{showScene($('#scene-letter'));onLetterEnter();},1150);}
pwInput.addEventListener('input',()=>{if(curScene!=='scene-pass'||pwState!=='idle'){pwInput.value='';return;}const v=pwInput.value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z]/g,'');if(v.length>typed.length)onChar(v[v.length-1]);else if(v.length<typed.length){typed=typed.slice(0,v.length);renderBoxes();}});
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(curScene==='scene-pass'&&pwState==='idle'&&/^[a-zA-Z]$/.test(e.key)&&document.activeElement!==pwInput)onChar(e.key);});
$('#scene-pass').addEventListener('click',()=>pwInput.focus());
pwInput.focus();

/* 信纸 */
const scrollWrap=$('#scrollWrap'),paperViewport=$('#paperViewport'),paperSurface=$('#paperSurface'),rollerBottom=$('#rollerBottom'),rollBundle=$('#rollBundle'),rollBtn=$('#rollBtn');
let letterRolled=false;
function onLetterEnter(){letterRolled=false;setTimeout(()=>{fitPaperToViewport();setTimeout(()=>rollBtn.classList.add('show'),700);},1300);}
function fitPaperToViewport(){paperSurface.style.transform='none';paperSurface.style.width='100%';void paperSurface.offsetWidth;const vpH=paperViewport.clientHeight;if(paperSurface.scrollHeight<=vpH){paperSurface.style.transform='none';return;}
/* 要迭代着算：把纸放大到 100/scale 宽之后，文字少折几行、实际高度会变矮，
   只按 100% 宽估一次的话，底部就会留下一条永远填不满的空缺。 */
let scale=vpH/paperSurface.scrollHeight;
for(let i=0;i<5;i++){paperSurface.style.width=(100/scale)+'%';paperSurface.style.transform='scale('+scale+')';void paperSurface.offsetWidth;const next=vpH/paperSurface.scrollHeight;if(Math.abs(next-scale)<0.0015){scale=next;break;}scale=next;}
paperSurface.style.width=(100/scale)+'%';paperSurface.style.transform='scale('+scale+')';}
addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(curScene==='scene-letter'&&!letterRolled)fitPaperToViewport();});
let pDown=null;
paperViewport.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{pDown={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,t:performance.now()};});
paperViewport.addEventListener('pointerup',e=>{if(!pDown)return;const dist=Math.hypot(e.clientX-pDown.x,e.clientY-pDown.y);const dur=performance.now()-pDown.t;pDown=null;if(dist<12&&dur<450)triggerRollUp();});
rollBtn.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();triggerRollUp();});
function triggerRollUp(){if(letterRolled)return;letterRolled=true;rollBtn.classList.add('clicked');sndPaper();setTimeout(startRollUp,500);}
function startRollUp(){const wrapH=scrollWrap.offsetHeight;const dur=2200;const t0=performance.now();function frame(now){const p=Math.min(1,(now-t0)/dur);const e=easeInOutSine(p);const paperH=Math.max(0,wrapH*(1-e));paperViewport.style.height=paperH+'px';rollerBottom.style.bottom=(wrapH-paperH-22)+'px';rollBundle.style.height=(6+e*34)+'px';if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(frame);else showScene($('#scene-scroll'));}requestAnimationFrame(frame);}
$('#scrollRoll').addEventListener('click',()=>{setTimeout(startMatch,200);});

/* 火柴蛋糕 */
const matchEl=$('#match'),matchFlameEl=$('#matchFlame'),boxEl=$('#matchbox'),lightPool=$('#lightPool'),cakeEl=$('#cake'),candlesEl=$('#candles'),wishUI=$('#wishUI'),wishBtn=$('#wishBtn'),blowUI=$('#blowUI'),micStatusEl=$('#micStatus');
const candleFlames=[...candlesEl.querySelectorAll('.flame')];
const FLAME_OFF=82,HEAD_OFF=44;
matchEl._t={x:150,y:230,r:30,s:1};
function applyMatch(x,y,r,s){matchEl._t={x,y,r,s};matchEl.style.transform='translate('+x+'px,'+y+'px) rotate('+r+'deg) scale('+s+')';}
applyMatch(150,230,30,1);
function tweenMatch(to,dur,opts){return new Promise(res=>{const o=opts||{};const ease=o.ease||easeIO,onFrame=o.onFrame;const from={x:matchEl._t.x,y:matchEl._t.y,r:matchEl._t.r,s:matchEl._t.s};const toS=(to.s===undefined)?from.s:to.s;const t0=performance.now();function f(now){const p=Math.min(1,(now-t0)/dur);const e=ease(p);applyMatch(lerp(from.x,to.x,e),lerp(from.y,to.y,e),lerp(from.r,to.r,e),lerp(from.s,toS,e));if(onFrame)onFrame(e);if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(f);else res();}requestAnimationFrame(f);});}
function bodyOffset(off,r,s){const rad=r*Math.PI/180;return{x:off*s*Math.sin(rad),y:-off*s*Math.cos(rad)};}
function flameScreenPos(){const o=bodyOffset(FLAME_OFF,matchEl._t.r,matchEl._t.s);return{x:innerWidth*.5+matchEl._t.x+o.x,y:innerHeight*.6+matchEl._t.y+o.y};}
function headScreenPos(){const o=bodyOffset(HEAD_OFF,matchEl._t.r,matchEl._t.s);return{x:innerWidth*.5+matchEl._t.x+o.x,y:innerHeight*.6+matchEl._t.y+o.y};}
function putHeadAt(hx,hy,r,s){const o=bodyOffset(HEAD_OFF,r,s);applyMatch(hx-innerWidth*.5-o.x,hy-innerHeight*.6-o.y,r,s);}
function poolFollow(){const fr=matchFlameEl.getBoundingClientRect();lightPool.style.transform='translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.5)';lightPool.style.left=(fr.left+fr.width/2)+'px';lightPool.style.top=(fr.top+fr.height*.6)+'px';}
const stripEl=$('#strikeStrip'),strikeHintEl=$('#strikeHint');
const MATCH_S=.84,MATCH_R=108,SLIDE_NEED=110;
let strikePhase=false,ignited=false,dragging=false,dragEverStarted=false;
let dragOff={x:0,y:0},lastPt=null,slideDist=0,lastScrapeAt=0,autoTimer=null;
function sparkAt(x,y){const n=2+(Math.random()*3|0);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=-Math.PI/2+(Math.random()-.5)*2.4;const sp=1.1+Math.random()*3.6;spawnPart(x+(Math.random()-.5)*10,y+(Math.random()-.5)*4,{cls:'sparkP',size:1.2+Math.random()*1.8,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp-.4,g:.12,max:260+Math.random()*280});}}
function onStrip(x,y){const s=stripEl.getBoundingClientRect();const padX=16,padY=26;return x>s.left-padX&&x<s.right+padX&&y>s.top-padY&&y<s.bottom+padY;}
function scrape(hx,hy){if(!onStrip(hx,hy)){lastPt=null;return;}if(lastPt){const d=Math.hypot(hx-lastPt.x,hy-lastPt.y);if(d>1.2){slideDist+=d;if(Math.random()<.6)sparkAt(hx,hy);const now=performance.now();if(now-lastScrapeAt>95){lastScrapeAt=now;sndScrape();}}}lastPt={x:hx,y:hy};if(slideDist>SLIDE_NEED)igniteMatch();}
function igniteMatch(){if(ignited||!strikePhase)return;strikePhase=false;ignited=true;dragging=false;clearTimeout(autoTimer);strikeHintEl.classList.remove('show');matchEl.classList.remove('hint');sndStrike();sndIgnite();matchFlameEl.classList.add('lit');lightPool.classList.add('following');lightPool.style.opacity='.9';poolFollow();startPinkMotes();afterIgnite();}
async function afterIgnite(){
  await sleep(420);
  const h=headScreenPos();const o=bodyOffset(HEAD_OFF,36,MATCH_S);
  await tweenMatch({x:h.x-innerWidth*.5-o.x,y:(h.y-40)-innerHeight*.6-o.y,r:36},620,{ease:easeIO,onFrame:poolFollow});
  await sleep(260);boxEl.classList.add('gone');
  await tweenMatch({x:0,y:-40,r:40,s:1},760,{ease:easeIO,onFrame:poolFollow});
  revealCake();await sleep(2600);
  lightPool.classList.add('following');
  for(let i=0;i<candleFlames.length;i++)await lightCandle(i);
  lightPool.classList.remove('following');
  const cr=cakeEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  lightPool.style.left=(cr.left+cr.width/2)+'px';lightPool.style.top=(cr.top+cr.height*.45)+'px';
  matchFlameEl.classList.remove('lit');stopPinkMotes();smokeAt(flameScreenPos(),5);
  await tweenMatch({x:170,y:250,r:18},950,{ease:easeIn});
  await sleep(800);wishUI.classList.add('show');
}
async function autoStrike(){if(ignited||dragEverStarted||!strikePhase)return;dragEverStarted=true;const s=stripEl.getBoundingClientRect();const x=s.left+s.width*.5;const yTop=s.top+12,yBot=s.bottom-12;const o=bodyOffset(HEAD_OFF,MATCH_R,MATCH_S);await tweenMatch({x:x-innerWidth*.5-o.x,y:yTop-innerHeight*.6-o.y,r:MATCH_R,s:MATCH_S},300,{ease:easeOut});await new Promise(res=>{const t0=performance.now(),dur=2000;function f(now){const p=Math.min(1,(now-t0)/dur);const hy=lerp(yTop,yBot,easeIO(p));putHeadAt(x,hy,MATCH_R,MATCH_S);if(p<1&&Math.random()<.75)sparkAt(x,hy);const nm=performance.now();if(nm-lastScrapeAt>80){lastScrapeAt=nm;sndScrape();}if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(f);else res();}requestAnimationFrame(f);});slideDist=SLIDE_NEED+50;igniteMatch();}
function onPointerDown(e){if(!strikePhase||ignited)return;const h=headScreenPos();if(Math.hypot(e.clientX-h.x,e.clientY-h.y)>135)return;dragging=true;dragEverStarted=true;clearTimeout(autoTimer);strikeHintEl.classList.remove('show');matchEl.classList.remove('hint');const lift=(e.pointerType==='mouse')?0:-34;dragOff={x:h.x-e.clientX,y:h.y-e.clientY+lift};putHeadAt(e.clientX+dragOff.x,e.clientY+dragOff.y,MATCH_R,MATCH_S);scrape(e.clientX+dragOff.x,e.clientY+dragOff.y);e.preventDefault();}
function onPointerMove(e){if(!dragging||ignited)return;const hx=e.clientX+dragOff.x,hy=e.clientY+dragOff.y;putHeadAt(hx,hy,MATCH_R,MATCH_S);scrape(hx,hy);}
function onPointerUp(){if(!dragging)return;dragging=false;lastPt=null;}
$('#scene-match').addEventListener('pointerdown',onPointerDown);
window.addEventListener('pointermove',onPointerMove);
window.addEventListener('pointerup',onPointerUp);
function revealCake(){const r=cakeEl.getBoundingClientRect();lightPool.classList.remove('following');lightPool.style.left=(r.left+r.width/2)+'px';lightPool.style.top=(r.top+r.height*.45)+'px';lightPool.style.transform='translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)';lightPool.style.opacity='1';cakeEl.classList.add('show');setTimeout(startDreamyMotes,900);}
async function moveFlameTo(tx,ty,dur){const cur=flameScreenPos();await tweenMatch({x:matchEl._t.x+(tx-cur.x),y:matchEl._t.y+(ty-cur.y),r:Math.max(18,matchEl._t.r-6)},dur,{onFrame:poolFollow});}
async function lightCandle(i){const c=candlesEl.children[i];const r=c.getBoundingClientRect();await moveFlameTo(r.left+r.width/2,r.top-6,640);candleFlames[i].classList.add('lit');sndCandlePop();if(i===0){startCakeDynamics();}await sleep(330);}
let cakeDynTimer=null;
function startCakeDynamics(){stopCakeDynamics();const cl=document.getElementById('candleLight');if(cl)cl.classList.add('on');const t0=performance.now();function tick(now){if(!cakeDynTimer)return;const t=(now-t0)/1000;const flick=0.72+0.14*Math.sin(t*4.3)+0.08*Math.sin(t*7.1+1.3)+0.06*Math.sin(t*11.7+2.5);if(cl)cl.style.opacity=flick.toFixed(3);cakeDynTimer=requestAnimationFrame(tick);}cakeDynTimer=requestAnimationFrame(tick);}
function stopCakeDynamics(){if(cakeDynTimer){cancelAnimationFrame(cakeDynTimer);cakeDynTimer=null;}const cl=document.getElementById('candleLight');if(cl){cl.classList.remove('on');cl.style.opacity='';}}
const parts=[];
function spawnPart(x,y,o){const el=document.createElement('div');el.className=o.cls;el.style.cssText='left:0;top:0;width:'+o.size+'px;height:'+o.size+'px;';$('#scene-match').appendChild(el);parts.push({x,y,vx:o.vx,vy:o.vy,g:o.g||0,life:0,max:o.max,size:o.size,cls:o.cls,el,seed:Math.random()*Math.PI*2});}
function smokeAt(p,n){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){spawnPart(p.x+(Math.random()-.5)*14,p.y+(Math.random()-.5)*8,{cls:'smokeP',size:9+Math.random()*7,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.5,vy:-.4-Math.random()*.7,g:-.002,max:1400+Math.random()*500});}}
function partLoop(){for(let i=parts.length-1;i>=0;i--){const p=parts[i];p.life+=16.7;if(p.life>=p.max){p.el.remove();parts.splice(i,1);continue;}p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vy+=p.g;const k=1-p.life/p.max;const s=p.cls==='smokeP'?1+p.life/p.max*2.4:1;let op=Math.max(0,k*(p.cls==='smokeP'?.8:.95));if(p.cls==='pinkP'||p.cls==='pinkP-soft')op*=0.55+0.45*(0.5+0.5*Math.sin(p.life*0.006+p.seed));p.el.style.transform='translate('+p.x+'px,'+p.y+'px) scale('+s+')';p.el.style.opacity=op;}requestAnimationFrame(partLoop);}
partLoop();
let pinkMoteTimer=null;
function startPinkMotes(){stopPinkMotes();pinkMoteTimer=setInterval(()=>{if(!ignited){stopPinkMotes();return;}const fr=matchFlameEl.getBoundingClientRect();if(fr.width===0)return;const cx=fr.left+fr.width/2,cy=fr.top+fr.height*.45;const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;const r=34+Math.random()*70;spawnPart(cx+Math.cos(a)*r,cy+Math.sin(a)*r*.7,{cls:'pinkP',size:2+Math.random()*3,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.35,vy:-0.3-Math.random()*.55,g:-0.0025,max:2000+Math.random()*1400});},150);}
function stopPinkMotes(){if(pinkMoteTimer){clearInterval(pinkMoteTimer);pinkMoteTimer=null;}}
let dreamMoteTimer=null;
function startDreamyMotes(){stopDreamyMotes();dreamMoteTimer=setInterval(()=>{const r=cakeEl.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.width===0||!cakeEl.classList.contains('show'))return;const cx=r.left+r.width/2;const cy=r.top+r.height*0.55;const ang=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;const rad=Math.pow(Math.random(),0.55);const px=cx+Math.cos(ang)*r.width*0.65*rad;const py=cy+Math.sin(ang)*r.height*0.55*rad;const isSoft=Math.random()<0.35;spawnPart(px,py,{cls:isSoft?'pinkP-soft':'pinkP',size:isSoft?(7+Math.random()*10):(1.8+Math.random()*3.2),vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.35,vy:-0.12-Math.random()*0.35,g:-0.0012,max:2600+Math.random()*2600});},130);}
function stopDreamyMotes(){if(dreamMoteTimer){clearInterval(dreamMoteTimer);dreamMoteTimer=null;}}
let matchStarted=false;
function startMatch(){if(matchStarted)return;matchStarted=true;showScene($('#scene-match'));runMatch();}
async function runMatch(){await sleep(900);const o=bodyOffset(HEAD_OFF,MATCH_R,MATCH_S);await tweenMatch({x:innerWidth*.2-innerWidth*.5-o.x,y:innerHeight*.64-innerHeight*.6-o.y,r:MATCH_R,s:MATCH_S},850,{ease:easeOut});matchEl.classList.add('hint');strikeHintEl.classList.add('show');strikePhase=true;autoTimer=setTimeout(autoStrike,3500);}
wishBtn.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();wishUI.classList.remove('show');blowUI.classList.add('show');initMic();setTimeout(()=>{blowActive=true;micLoop();},300);});
let micOk=false,micAnalyser=null,micStream=null,blowActive=false,blown=false,blowHits=0;
async function initMic(){if(!navigator.mediaDevices||!navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia){micOk=false;micStatusEl.textContent='🎤 麦克风不可用，点屏幕吹灭';return;}micStatusEl.textContent='🎤 正在请求麦克风权限…';try{const stream=await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:true});const ctx=AC();if(!ctx){stream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop());micOk=false;return;}micStream=stream;const src=ctx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);micAnalyser=ctx.createAnalyser();micAnalyser.fftSize=512;src.connect(micAnalyser);micOk=true;micStatusEl.textContent='🎤 麦克风已就绪，吹一口气吧';}catch(e){micOk=false;micStatusEl.textContent='🎤 麦克风不可用，点屏幕吹灭';}}
function micLoop(){if(!blowActive||blown)return;if(micOk&&micAnalyser){const d=new Uint8Array(micAnalyser.fftSize);micAnalyser.getByteTimeDomainData(d);let s=0;for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++){const v=(d[i]-128)/128;s+=v*v;}const rms=Math.sqrt(s/d.length);if(rms>.22)blowHits++;else blowHits=Math.max(0,blowHits-1);if(blowHits>=3)blow();}setTimeout(micLoop,60);}
$('#scene-match').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(blowActive)blow();});
const finalTipEl=$('#finalTip');
let starsReady=false,finalAdvancing=false;
function blow(){if(blown||!blowActive)return;blown=true;blowActive=false;stopPinkMotes();stopDreamyMotes();stopCakeDynamics();if(micStream)micStream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop());sndBlow();candleFlames.forEach(f=>f.classList.add('out'));candleFlames.forEach(f=>{const r=f.getBoundingClientRect();smokeAt({x:r.left+r.width/2,y:r.top+r.height},3);});lightPool.style.opacity='.12';blowUI.classList.remove('show');
  /* 这一段原本会在文字页进场时放一段 24 音的旋律（sndMelody）当背景音。
   2026-10-19 加了《Sweet (feat. Landon Sears)》做全程背景音乐之后，
   两段叠在一起打架，按用户要求把这里的「原来的背景音乐」去掉。
   2026-10-20 晚一度把整段背景音乐从产物里拿掉，当天晚些时候又按用户要求放回来了 ——
   还是《Sweet (feat. Landon Sears)》这一首（见 src\bgm\）。
   结束语那一幕的 sndMelody()（在 extras.js 的 showCallEnd 里）保留没动。 */
setTimeout(()=>{showScene($('#scene-final'));setTimeout(()=>{starsReady=true;finalTipEl.classList.add('ready');},6600);},2200);
}
$('#scene-final').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(curScene!=='scene-final'||!starsReady||finalAdvancing)return;
  finalAdvancing=true;starsReady=false;finalTipEl.classList.remove('ready');
  const yStar=document.querySelector('.final-lines .yellow-star');
  if(yStar){yStar.style.transition='transform .55s, opacity .55s';yStar.style.transform='scale(1.5)';yStar.style.opacity='0';}
  setTimeout(()=>{initStarScene();showScene($('#scene-stars'));finalAdvancing=false;},500);
});

/* 20 颗星 */
const starMessages=['我希望你以后，碰到那些都是好的人都是对的人，都是不会伤你的人。','愿你永远保留一点好奇心，去认识这个很大的世界。','愿你拥有健康的身体，也记得好好照顾自己。','愿你成为自己的太阳，无需凭借谁的光。','祝你时时峥嵘，如春在野。','希望你的眼睛一直笑，想要的都得到。','愿你的生活如四叶草般充满爱，希望，信仰与好运！','祝你，没有永远的梅雨季只有久违的艳阳天。','愿你快乐，不止生日。','愿你以后回头看今天的时候，会觉得20岁是一个很好的开始。','愿你偶尔迷茫的时候，页相信自己正在慢慢成长。','Cento di questi giorni!','Ti auguro un giorno speciale così come tu sei!','愿你一切为之努力的事情，都有浪漫的结果。','愿你眼中总有光，活成你想要的模样。','愿你崭新的时光通透温热','愿你不必一直坚强，偶尔也可以放心做个小朋友。','希望你像晴天一样明媚然后好好吃饭，别流眼泪。','一切惊喜都是，因为你很珍贵，只要尽情享受就好啦。','生日不仅是庆祝你的出生，更是庆祝你的存在 。'];
const starCardEl=$('#starCard'),starIdxEl=$('#starIdx'),starTextEl=$('#starText'),starCloseEl=$('#starClose'),starFinalEl=$('#starFinal'),starCounterEl=$('#starCounter');
let starOpen=false,starAutoTimer=null,starVisited=new Set(),isGathering=false;
function initStarScene(){
  const group=$('#starsGroup');group.innerHTML='';
  const positions=[[180,420],[340,395],[290,560],[310,690],[380,800],[480,870],[590,890],[700,860],[790,800],[860,720],[905,625],[945,530],[990,435],[1060,360],[1150,285],[1255,320],[1285,425],[1235,530],[1160,620],[1255,670]];
  positions.forEach((p,i)=>{
    const use=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','use');
    use.setAttribute('href','#starShape');
    use.setAttribute('transform',`translate(${p[0]},${p[1]}) scale(3)`);
    use.setAttribute('class','star');
    use.dataset.i=i+1;
    use.addEventListener('click',e=>{
      e.stopPropagation();
      if(isGathering)return;
      const idx=parseInt(use.dataset.i,10);
      /* 已经点开过的星星也能再点，卡片照常重播，但不再重复计数 */
      if(use.classList.contains('visited')){openStarCard(idx);return;}
      use.classList.add('visited');starVisited.add(idx);openStarCard(idx);
      starCounterEl.textContent=`${starVisited.size} / 20`;
      if(starVisited.size>=20){setTimeout(()=>{closeStarCard();setTimeout(gatherStars,300);},1500);}
    });
    group.appendChild(use);
  });
  starVisited.clear();starCounterEl.textContent='0 / 20';starCounterEl.classList.remove('hide');
  const svg=document.querySelector('.stars-svg');if(svg){svg.style.opacity='';svg.style.transition='';}
  isGathering=false;
}
/* 提示卡文案排版：卡片正文一行最多 STAR_MAXW 个字（= 卡片净宽 ÷ 单字宽），
   超过就换行，换行点优先落在标点 / 空格上。新算法是「贪心成行 + 全局均衡候选」，
   踩过的坑都在下面：
     1. 候选断点必须两侧都不太短。太靠前的标点会把上半句砍成三五个字（「祝你，」），
        收尾的句号也会让最后一行只剩一个句号。
     2. 一行最多 STAR_MAXW 字；下一个候选断点还没到时就按 MAXW 断，
        不要为了凑到下一个逗号把一行拉成 20+ 字。
     3. 硬断不能劈开英文单词，意大利语那两条必须先滑到词边界。
     4. 一个候选都没有时退回中点均衡硬断。 */
const STAR_BREAK_MARKS=['，','。','；','、','！','？','!','?'];
const STAR_BALANCE=0.28;                            /* 候选断点：两侧至少各占全文这个比例 */
const STAR_MAXW=16;                                 /* 一行最多几个字 */
const STAR_MIN=4;                                   /* 断出来的每一段至少几个字 */
function splitStarText(t){
  const s=String(t||'').trim();
  const n=s.length;
  /* 纯西文/数字（意大利语那两条）一律不分行：中文按 STAR_MAXW 断行是为了卡片高度可控，
     西文本来就是横向排的，断成三行反而像在读标语。字号交给 fitSingleLine 缩。 */
  if(!/[　-〿一-鿿＀-￯]/.test(s))return [s];
  if(n<=STAR_MAXW)return [s];                       /* 短的保持一行 */

  /* 1) 全局候选断点：标点或空格，且两侧都不太短 */
  const minLen=n*STAR_BALANCE;
  const cands=[];
  for(let i=0;i<n-1;i++){
    const ch=s.charAt(i);
    if(STAR_BREAK_MARKS.indexOf(ch)<0&&ch!==' ')continue;
    const brk=i+1;                                  /* 在 brk 之前断开，前半句含标点 */
    if(brk>=minLen&&n-brk>=minLen)cands.push(brk);
  }

  /* 2) 一个候选都没有 → 中点均衡硬断，不制造 16/4 这种一头长一头短的形状 */
  if(!cands.length){
    const mid=Math.floor(n/2)-1;
    return [s.slice(0,mid+1).trim(),s.slice(mid+1).trim()];
  }

  /* 3) 贪心成行 */
  const isWord=function(ch){return /[0-9A-Za-zÀ-ɏ]/.test(ch);};   /* 含意大利语重音字母 */
  const safeCut=function(from,want){
    let c=Math.min(want,n);
    if(c<=from)return from+1;
    /* 两边都是字母数字说明劈在词中间，向后滑到下一个安全边界 */
    while(c<n&&isWord(s.charAt(c-1))&&isWord(s.charAt(c)))c++;
    return c>=n?Math.min(want,n):c;
  };
  const out=[];
  let start=0;
  for(;;){
    if(n-start>STAR_MAXW){
      let brk=-1;
      for(let k=0;k<cands.length;k++){
        const c=cands[k];
        if(c>start&&c<=start+STAR_MAXW)brk=c;       /* 取最靠后的那个 */
      }
      if(brk<0)brk=safeCut(start,start+STAR_MAXW);
      if(brk<=start)break;                          /* 防御：别死循环 */
      out.push(s.slice(start,brk).trim());
      start=brk;
      continue;
    }
    /* 余下不足一行：如果还有个候选断点能把尾巴拆成两段都不短的，就再断一次。
       没有这一步，长句在硬断之后会被压成一整坨 —— 参考图那句就靠它断成 16 / 6 / 9。 */
    let brk=-1;
    for(let k=0;k<cands.length;k++){
      const c=cands[k];
      if(c>=start+STAR_MIN&&n-c>=STAR_MIN&&c-start<=STAR_MAXW)brk=c;
    }
    if(brk>0){out.push(s.slice(start,brk).trim());start=brk;}
    const tail=s.slice(start).trim();
    if(tail)out.push(tail);
    break;
  }
  /* 4) 收尾：把只剩一两个字的孤行并回上一行（「…tu se」「!」这种） */
  while(out.length>1&&out[out.length-1].length<STAR_MIN){
    const last=out.pop();
    out[out.length-1]+=last;
  }
  return out.length?out:[s];
}
/* 某一行超宽（为了不劈开英文单词而放宽过）时把整张卡的字号降一档 */
function starCardFit(lines){
  let mx=0;
  for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++)mx=Math.max(mx,lines[i].length);
  starTextEl.style.setProperty('--cf',
    mx>19?'clamp(13px,2.5vw,17px)':(mx>17?'clamp(15px,3.0vw,20px)':'clamp(18px,3.8vw,25px)'));
  if(lines.length===1)fitSingleLine();
}
/* 单行（西文那两条）按实测宽度缩字号，保证 nowrap 下不溢出卡片。
   card-text 是 nowrap，所以这里必须真量 scrollWidth，不能只按字数估。 */
function fitSingleLine(){
  const cs=getComputedStyle(starCardEl);
  const box=starCardEl.clientWidth-parseFloat(cs.paddingLeft)-parseFloat(cs.paddingRight);
  if(!(box>40))return;                              /* 卡片还没布局好，跳过 */
  let fs=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(starTextEl).fontSize)||20;
  starTextEl.style.fontSize=fs+'px';
  let guard=0;
  while(starTextEl.scrollWidth>box&&fs>8.5&&guard++<80){
    fs=Math.max(8.5,fs-0.5);
    starTextEl.style.fontSize=fs+'px';
  }
}
function openStarCard(i){
  const lines=splitStarText(starMessages[i-1]);
  starIdxEl.textContent=String(i).padStart(2,'0');
  starTextEl.innerHTML=lines.join('<br>');
  starTextEl.style.fontSize='';                     /* 清掉上一张的行内字号，否则只会越缩越小 */
  starCardFit(lines);
  starCardEl.classList.add('show');
  starOpen=true;
  if(starAutoTimer)clearTimeout(starAutoTimer);
  starAutoTimer=setTimeout(closeStarCard,5000);
}
function closeStarCard(){if(!starOpen)return;starCardEl.classList.remove('show');starOpen=false;if(starAutoTimer){clearTimeout(starAutoTimer);starAutoTimer=null;}}
/* 天蝎座：20 颗星各就各位。坐标系是一张 1000×620 的画布（已经铺满整个框），
   p=坐标、s=大小倍率、k:'ring' 表示画成空心圆（和参考图里的几个关键星一样）。 */
const SCORPIUS=[
  {p:[829, 70],s:1.35},{p:[940,134],s:1,k:'ring'},{p:[757,164],s:.85},{p:[853,188],s:.85},
  {p:[898,261],s:1.3},{p:[798,300],s:.85},{p:[619,261],s:.95,k:'ring'},{p:[586,359],s:.9},
  {p:[650,188],s:.7},{p:[492,486],s:1.3},{p:[392,541],s:.9},{p:[223,545],s:.8},
  {p:[102,481],s:.9},{p:[194,422],s:.8},{p:[ 60,314],s:.85},{p:[343,291],s:.9},
  {p:[290,508],s:.65},{p:[156,530],s:.65},{p:[495,388],s:.65},{p:[780,339],s:.65}
];
/* 连线：头部七边形 → 颈 → 蝎身三角 → 蝎尾 → 螫刺两叉（两个叉尖都是自由端） */
const SCORPIUS_LINES=[
  [0,1],[1,3],[3,4],[4,5],[5,6],[6,2],[2,0],
  [5,19],[19,7],[7,18],[18,9],[9,7],
  [9,16],[16,10],[10,17],[17,11],
  [11,12],[12,13],[13,14],[13,15]
];
function gatherStars(){
  if(isGathering)return;isGathering=true;
  starCounterEl.classList.add('hide');
  const svg=document.querySelector('.stars-svg');
  svg.style.transition='opacity .6s';svg.style.opacity='0';
  const stars=document.querySelectorAll('.stars-svg .star');
  const W=window.innerWidth,H=window.innerHeight;
  /* 星座整体铺在上方，下方留给「20 颗星星，都送给你」 */
  const boxW=Math.min(W*0.86,980),boxH=boxW*0.62;
  const boxX=(W-boxW)/2,boxY=Math.max(H*0.05,34);
  const sx=x=>boxX+x/1000*boxW, sy=y=>boxY+y/620*boxH;
  const wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.id='starGatherOverlay';document.body.appendChild(wrap);
  /* 星座连线先铺在最底下，等星到位了再一起亮出来 */
  const lineSvg=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','svg');
  lineSvg.setAttribute('class','constellation');
  lineSvg.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 '+W+' '+H);
  lineSvg.setAttribute('preserveAspectRatio','none');
  const gEl=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','g');
  SCORPIUS_LINES.forEach(seg=>{
    const l=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','line');
    l.setAttribute('x1',sx(SCORPIUS[seg[0]].p[0]));l.setAttribute('y1',sy(SCORPIUS[seg[0]].p[1]));
    l.setAttribute('x2',sx(SCORPIUS[seg[1]].p[0]));l.setAttribute('y2',sy(SCORPIUS[seg[1]].p[1]));
    gEl.appendChild(l);
  });
  lineSvg.appendChild(gEl);wrap.appendChild(lineSvg);
  stars.forEach((star,index)=>{
    const rect=star.getBoundingClientRect();
    const el=document.createElement('div');
    const spec=SCORPIUS[index]||{p:[500,310],s:.7};
    el.className='gather-star'+(spec.k==='ring'?' ring':'');
    el.style.left=(rect.left+rect.width/2)+'px';el.style.top=(rect.top+rect.height/2)+'px';
    wrap.appendChild(el);
    void el.offsetWidth;
    setTimeout(()=>{
      el.style.left=sx(spec.p[0])+'px';el.style.top=sy(spec.p[1])+'px';
      el.style.transform='translate(-50%,-50%) scale('+spec.s+')';
      setTimeout(()=>el.classList.add('blink'),1200);
    },index*45);
  });
  setTimeout(()=>{starFinalEl.classList.add('show');armParkEntry();},2400);
}
document.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(starOpen)closeStarCard();});
starCloseEl.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();closeStarCard();});

window.addEventListener('pointerdown',function unlock(){AC();window.removeEventListener('pointerdown',unlock);},{once:true});
/* =============================================================
   背景音乐 · Sweet (feat. Landon Sears) — Bren Joy / Landon Sears
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   音频整份以 base64 内嵌进产物（和沙盘 / 3D 翻盖机同一个路子），
   所以产物依旧是 ONE 个自包含 html：file:// 双击能开，离线也能响。

   为什么用 Blob 而不是 data: URL：
   4.4 MB 的 base64 塞进 src 属于超长 URL，有些浏览器会挑毛病；
   走 Blob URL（atob → Uint8Array → Blob）没有长度上限，
   而且这封信里沙盘和翻盖机已经是这么干的（PHONE_B64 / PARK_B64）。

   自动播放策略：没有用户手势浏览器不让播。
   这封信的第一次交互是「在密码框里敲第一个字」，
   所以这里盯着第一次 pointerdown / keydown / touchstart 开播 ——
   那一下正好带着用户激活（user activation），play() 不会被拦。
   万一还是被拦了（无手势直接打开、或者浏览器策略更严），
   就把左上角那颗音符点亮并提示一句，点一下照样能开。

   音量压得很低（0.26），而且每次音效响起都会把音乐往下压一档，
   免得两个声音打架 —— 音量只有一个地方在写（bgmPump），
   淡入淡出和「压低」都走这一条路，不会互相打架。
   ============================================================= */
var BGM_B64 = '
